Subject: Kickoff triage & next asks — Nebula POC paused

Thanks again for the call earlier, Tom — appreciate you and the team walking through the use case. Quick recap and suggested plan so we keep momentum: 

1) Objectives we agreed: 30-day POC to validate throughput and cost per inference for your batch ingestion pipeline; success metric = <100ms 90th percentile for 512-token requests + integrated caching.
2) Immediate blockers we identified: network egress rules for the private agent, and S3 bucket access for your sample dataset.
3) Next steps (owners):
   - Nebula: confirm network window and provide a temporary s3 read-only URI (Tom / Liam) — target: EOD Aug 25
   - Redwood: schedule a 90-minute hands-on kickoff to deploy the private agent and run a smoke test (Vanessa / Monica) — propose Aug 26 or 27
   - Contract: Jonas to share the SOW and temporary trial addendum for signature

I've attached a short onboarding checklist and our minimal network requirements to make the first run smooth. If those dates don't work, tell me what does and we'll adjust — the goal is to get a single successful smoke run so your infra team can validate the flow.

Attachments: [Attachment: POC-checklist.pdf (PDF)], [Attachment: network-requirements.docx (DOCX)]

Thanks — looking forward to your confirmation.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz

Date: 2026-08-31T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Kickoff triage & next asks — Nebula POC paused

Internal note — looping you in to show the sequence. No reply yet from Tom or Liam. A couple of options I want to propose:

- Option A: Light-touch CS kickoff next week (Monica runs the 60–90 min session with basic infra checklist). We try to get the smoke run within 7 business days.
- Option B: Pause the scheduled trial window and offer a 30-day flexible window once Nebula has the network and S3 confirmed.

Jonas — if you can push the SOW/addendum today that usually helps procurement move faster. If I don't hear back from Tom by EOD Sep 1 I'll send a quick bump and offer a narrower time slot (we've had luck with "two short options" approach).

I'd prefer Option A if the infra lift is minimal; if not, we pick B and preserve credits. Thoughts?

Thanks,
Vanessa

Subject: Quick follow-up — kickoff timing for Nebula POC

Hi Tom — wanted to follow up on the checklist I sent last week. I know things get busy; can you confirm whether Nebula prefers:

A) Try the hands-on kickoff this week (Aug 26/27 originally proposed), or
B) Move to a flexible 30-day window once your infra team gives the green light.

If A, I can lock a 90-minute slot with Monica tomorrow (Tue) at 10:00am PT or Wed at 2:00pm PT. If neither works, tell me two 1-hour windows that do and we’ll adapt.

If you'd rather pause, we can put the trial on hold and preserve the credits — no action required on your side other than a one-line confirm.

I didn't want to assume either way; leaning toward offering the narrower scheduling approach because we see teams get unstuck when it's concrete. Any update appreciated.

Best,
Vanessa

Tom / Liam / Procurement team —

Quick final check from our side: we haven't seen the network confirmation or S3 URI we requested and there hasn't been activity from the trial environment. To avoid drifting credits and confounding next steps, we'll do one of the following based on your reply by end of day Sep 4:

1) If you reply with a preferred kickoff window we will schedule the technical session and Monica will run the smoke test.
2) If you reply "pause," we will place the trial on hold and keep the environment reserved for 30 days so you can resume without losing the initial configuration.
3) If we don't hear anything by Sep 4 we'll auto-pause the trial and follow up with a light "are you still evaluating" note in two weeks.

If it helps, I can have Jonas create a short checklist for procurement items (SLA questions, trial addendum) or send a DocuSign link for the addendum to expedite.

Thanks for the quick response — we want to make this as low-friction as possible.

Regards,
